blurb: `trustFrom` names an environment variable whose JSON, when set, replaces the actor's declared trust roots at run time, as in a test or staging deployment. A variable is named by a string, so a number or other expression names nothing. Write the variable's name in quotes.
example:
type WorkloadId = String where NonEmpty

actor Workload { auth = Oidc(issuer = "https://i.test", audience = "a", jwks = "https://i.test/jwks", trustFrom = 5), identity = WorkloadId }   // ✗ not a name

actor Workload { auth = Oidc(issuer = "https://i.test", audience = "a", jwks = "https://i.test/jwks", trustFrom = "OIDC_TRUST"), identity = WorkloadId }   // ✓
summary: An `Oidc` actor's `trustFrom` isn't a string naming an environment variable.
